description: Turn a list of supplements into one custom supplement and a link to review and buy it on picardo.health. Pass each item as the person named it, with its amount and unit, and the ingredient_id from search_supplement_ingredients. Give the amount in the ingredient’s own unit from search; grams, milligrams and micrograms convert automatically, anything else, IU included, does not. Nothing is bought or saved here. Returns what the supplement contains, items that could not be included and why, amounts above or below what one daily serving can hold, capsules a day, the one-time price for a 60-day supply before shipping and tax, and the link. Takes ingredient names and amounts only, no health information. Purchases are for adults 18 and over, shipped within the United States. If the person says they are under 18 or live outside the United States, do not call this tool; explain that Picardo cannot sell to them.

amount.description: The daily amount, or null when none was given.

ingredient_id.description: The ingredient’s ID from search_supplement_ingredients, or null when it has none.

name.description: The supplement as the person named it.

unit.description: The unit of the amount, or null for the ingredient’s own unit.

name: draft_supplement_formula

asGiven.description: The item as the person named it.

outOfRange.description: Items left out because the amount is above or below what one daily serving can hold.

priceUsd.description: One-time price in US dollars for the whole supply, before shipping and tax. Null when no price is available here; the review page shows it.

unmatched.description: Items left out of the link, and why.

availableForm.description: The only form the ingredient comes in, when that is why.

expectedUnit.description: The unit to give the amount in, when known.

suggestions.description: Ingredients the person may have meant. Confirm one.

url.description: Null when nothing could be included.

title: Draft a custom supplement
